name: Fetch NXOS logs (password auth)
description: SFTP fetch using password. Replace host/user/password/remote with your values.

name: Fetch NXOS logs (key auth)
description: SFTP fetch using SSH key. Preferred over password auth.

name: Fetch legacy device logs
description: --legacy enables old KEX/cipher/MAC algorithms needed for older Cisco IOS/NX-OS SSH stacks.

name: Fetch specific date logs
description: Remote path uses {date} substitution — useful when the SFTP server stores logs in dated directories.

name: Dry-run fetch (list remote files only)
description: Shows what would be downloaded without actually transferring. Use to verify remote path and filename filter.

name: Parse a single file
description: Parse one specific .txt file. JSON lands in network_cli_parser/data/json/{date}/ automatically.

name: Parse all files in today's raw folder
description: Processes every .txt file in the dated raw directory. Most common usage.

name: Parse with platform override
description: Skip auto-detection and force the platform. Use when filename prefix detection is unreliable.

name: Parse into a custom output dir
description: Override default output location. The dated subdirectory is still created inside the custom path.

name: Collect via SSH (online mode)
description: SSH into devices defined in devices.yaml and collect + parse in one step. Requires netmiko installed.

name: Collect from existing raw dumps (offline)
description: Reprocess .txt dumps already on disk — equivalent to running main.py but invoked via report.py.

name: Health check — single device stdout
description: Run checks on one device; print JSON results to stdout. Good for quick inspection.

name: Health check — single device HTML
description: Write a self-contained HTML report for one device.

name: Health check — with device-specific overrides
description: Merge default checks with device-specific overrides. Device check wins on name clash.

name: Health check — verify-only CI mode
description: Run all checks and print results but write no output files. Exit code still reflects failures. Use in CI.

name: Health all — HTML combined report
description: Evaluate checks on every device in the snapshot dir. Writes one health_report.html with a check x device matrix.

name: Health all — JSON output per device
description: Write per-device health JSON files instead of HTML. Useful for downstream processing or CI artefacts.

name: Health all — HTML + JSON
description: Write both the combined HTML report and per-device JSON files.

name: Health all — recent snapshots only
description: Skip snapshots older than 2 days. Avoids stale data polluting the combined report.

name: Health all — verify-only
description: Run all checks across all devices; print results; write nothing. CI-safe read-only mode.

name: Health diff — compare two runs
description: Highlight regressions (pass→fail) and fixes (fail→pass) between two saved health report JSONs. Exit 1 on regressions.

name: Health diff — stdout JSON
description: Print the diff as JSON to stdout without writing a file.

name: Coverage analysis — with checks
description: Show which parsed commands have no health check (unchecked) and which checks reference commands not in the snapshot.

name: Coverage analysis — no checks (list parsed)
description: Without --checks: just list all parsed commands and their status. Useful as a quick inventory of what was collected.

name: Coverage analysis — save to JSON
description: Save coverage results as machine-readable JSON for tracking drift over time.

name: Delta — single device HTML
description: Field-level diff between yesterday's and today's snapshot for one device.

name: Delta — all devices HTML + index
description: Compare all matched devices across two snapshot directories. Writes per-device delta HTML files and an index.html.

name: Delta — all devices both formats
description: Write both HTML and JSON delta files per device.

name: Baseline — generate starter checks
description: Auto-generate a check YAML from current snapshot values. Review and delete dynamic fields (counters/uptime) before promoting to production.

name: Baseline — print to stdout
description: Preview the generated baseline YAML without saving it.
